# RustStream

> RustStream is a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. The core crate `ruststream` holds the traits, the router runtime, the codecs and an in-memory broker. Each broker (NATS, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, AMQP 1.0, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, SQS / SNS, Pulsar, MQTT 5, ZeroMQ, stream files, Kinesis) is a crate of its own.

A handler is an `async fn` under `#[subscriber(..)]`, mounted on a broker with `b.include(handler)`. It takes `&T` for one message or `&[T]` for a batch. A service imports `ruststream::prelude::*` or its broker crate's prelude. The codec is a compile-time type chosen at the mount site; JSON is the default. Misuse is rejected at compile time, and the compiler error names the fix.

This site holds the entry pages. How each topic is done lives in the module overviews on docs.rs, and a broker's own settings live in its crate's documentation.

## Getting started

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/): what RustStream does and its design principles
- [Installation](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/getting-started/installation/): the crate, its cargo features and a broker crate
- [Quick start](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/getting-started/quickstart/): a running service scaffolded with `cargo generate`
- [Tutorial](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/getting-started/tutorial/): an orders service with a message type, a handler, a reply and a router, on the in-memory broker

## Guides

- [Subscribers](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#subscribers): handlers, subscription sources, mount-site settings, batches, workers, dedicated threads for handlers that compute, delayed redelivery and its cap
- [Publishing](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#publishing): replies, `Out` slots, publish transforms and the publish pipeline
- [Routing](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#routing): routers, per-router codecs and layers
- [Context and state](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#context-and-state): the per-delivery context and the shared application state
- [Typed headers](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#typed-headers): headers read and written as serde types
- [Lifecycle](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#lifecycle): startup and shutdown hooks, the first publish after startup
- [Middleware](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#middleware): consume and publish layers
- [Failure policy](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#failure-policy): what a panic or an undecodable payload does to a delivery
- [Running beside another server](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/index.html#running-beside-another-server): `start()` and the running handle
- [Codecs](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/codec/index.html): JSON, CBOR and MessagePack, where a codec is chosen, and payloads that carry their own bytes
- [Testing](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/testing/index.html): testing a service's production app with `TestApp`, every broker in process, addressed by its production type
- [Testing against a running broker](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/testing/index.html#against-a-running-broker): `TestApp::start_live`, the same test body against a stand
- [AsyncAPI](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/asyncapi/index.html): the generated AsyncAPI document and its viewer
- [OpenTelemetry](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/otel/index.html): trace propagation, OTLP export and per-handler metrics
- [Prometheus metrics](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/metrics/index.html): consume and publish metrics
- [Logging](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/logging/index.html): console logging driven by `RUST_LOG`
- [Command line](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/runtime/cli/index.html): the entry point `#[ruststream::app]` generates and the `ruststream` command

## Brokers

- [Brokers](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/brokers/): the broker crates, and moving a service to another broker
- [In-memory broker](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/brokers/memory/): the broker inside one process, and the reference implementation of the contract
- [In-memory pattern subscriptions](https://docs.rs/ruststream/latest/ruststream/memory/index.html#pattern-subscriptions): `MemoryPattern` in the NATS subject syntax, and the `Routing` rule that picks every match or the most specific one
- [NATS](https://docs.rs/ruststream-nats): `ruststream-nats`, Core NATS and JetStream
- [Redis / Valkey](https://docs.rs/ruststream-fred): `ruststream-fred`, streams, lists and Pub/Sub
- [RabbitMQ](https://docs.rs/ruststream-lapin): `ruststream-lapin`, AMQP 0.9.1
- [Kafka](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rdkafka): `ruststream-rdkafka`, with the schema registry
- [AMQP 1.0](https://docs.rs/ruststream-amqp): `ruststream-amqp`
- [Google Cloud Pub/Sub](https://docs.rs/ruststream-gcp-pubsub): `ruststream-gcp-pubsub`
- [AWS SQS / SNS](https://docs.rs/ruststream-sqs-sns): `ruststream-sqs-sns`
- [Apache Pulsar](https://docs.rs/ruststream-pulsar): `ruststream-pulsar`
- [MQTT 5](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc): `ruststream-rumqttc`
- [ZeroMQ](https://docs.rs/ruststream-zeromq): `ruststream-zeromq`
- [Stream files / stdio](https://docs.rs/ruststream-sea-file): `ruststream-sea-file`
- [AWS Kinesis](https://docs.rs/ruststream-kinesis): `ruststream-kinesis`

## Broker authors

- [Writing a broker](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/broker-authors/): the traits a broker crate implements, the lazy-startup contract, the runtime a broker's own tasks run on and the in-process mode
- [A worked example: NATS](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/broker-authors/example-nats/): a broker crate built step by step
- [Conformance](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/broker-authors/conformance/): the harness that checks a broker against the contract
- [Template contract](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/broker-authors/templates/): the `cargo generate` template a broker crate ships

## Optional

- [API reference](https://docs.rs/ruststream): the full rustdoc of the core crate
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/benchmarks/): what the framework costs over a raw client, and the cost of its own code
- [Source](https://github.com/powersemmi/ruststream): the core repository
